newsitem.title: USA: Starwood Lodging to acquire Mexican resorts.
newsitem.headline: Starwood Lodging to acquire Mexican resorts.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Trust and Starwood Lodging Corp said Tuesday they have entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a portfolio of three full-service, luxury properties located in destination resorts in Mexico.

The trust and the corporation issued a news release saying the portfolio will be purchased from Bancomer SA, a subsidiary of Grupo Financiero Bancomer SA de CV, for about $133 million, or about $150,000 per key.
The purchase is expected to be primarily financed by a $118 million LIBOR based loan from Bancomer with the Bank of Montreal as financial advisor, the news release said.

The portfolio consists of the 229-room Westin Regina Resort in Los Cabos, Mexico; the 385-room Westin Regina Resort in Cancun, Mexico; and the 280-room Westin Regina Resort in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, the news release said.
The transaction is scheduled to close in August 1997 and it is anticipated that the properties will continue to be flagged under the Westin name, Starwood said.
